keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «거북의 다리가 비닐봉지와 그물에 엉킨 것(문제)» 과 «아빠가 거북을 잡고 지수가 비닐을 잘라 낸 것(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the turtle's legs were tangled in plastic and a net) and the solution (Jisu and her dad cut the plastic away). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: A sea turtle's legs were tangled in plastic and a fishing net.
They cut the plastic away, and the turtle went back to the sea.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why was the sea turtle not moving well?
opts: Its legs were tangled in plastic and a net.
It was sleeping in the sun.
Jisu was holding it in her hands.
evs: Near the rocks, she saw a small sea turtle that was not moving well.
Its legs were tangled in an old plastic bag and a fishing net.
When it was free, the turtle slowly crawled back into the waves.
Jisu looked around and saw bottles, cups, and bags everywhere on the sand.
why: 거북의 다리가 낡은 비닐봉지와 그물에 엉켜 있었다고 나와 있어요.
The text says its legs were tangled in an old plastic bag and a fishing net.

qs.q: In "When it was free," what does "free" mean?
qs.qko: «When it was free» 에서 «free» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: the plastic was no longer around its legs
it did not cost any money
it was very tired and sleepy
evs: Her dad carefully held the turtle while Jisu gently cut the plastic away with small scissors.
On a sunny morning, Jisu walked along the beach with her dad.
"This trash can hurt so many animals," she said sadly.
That afternoon, she and her dad picked up three bags of trash.
why: 바로 앞에서 지수가 비닐을 잘라 냈어요. 그래서 다리를 묶던 것이 없어졌다는 뜻이에요.
Just before, Jisu cut the plastic away. So «free» means nothing was holding its legs anymore.

qs.q: What two things did Jisu do to help sea animals?
qs.qko: 지수는 바다 동물을 돕기 위해 어떤 두 가지 일을 했나요?
opts: She freed a turtle and picked up trash on the beach.
She took the turtle home as a pet.
She bought a new fishing net.
evs: Her dad carefully held the turtle while Jisu gently cut the plastic away with small scissors.
That afternoon, she and her dad picked up three bags of trash.
On a sunny morning, Jisu walked along the beach with her dad.
Jisu looked around and saw bottles, cups, and bags everywhere on the sand.
why: 지수는 거북에게서 비닐을 잘라 냈고, 오후에는 아빠와 쓰레기 세 봉지를 주웠어요. 두 문장을 이으면 알 수 있어요.
Jisu cut the plastic off the turtle, and that afternoon she and her dad picked up three bags of trash.

ends: Jisu asks her class to clean the beach together.
지수가 반 친구들에게 함께 바닷가를 청소하자고 해요.
Jisu sees the same turtle swimming in the sea.
지수가 바다에서 헤엄치는 그 거북을 다시 봐요.

write.src: “Let’s <u>pick up the trash on the beach</u> so that <u>sea animals stay safe</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그러면 생기는 좋은 점» 으로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we can do together and the good thing that happens in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을 한다» 를 넣어 보세요. (예: so that the birds are safe)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + what happens. (e.g. so that the birds are safe)

img.cover: On a sunny beach near some rocks, a girl with short black hair, a red cap and a blue T-shirt kneels beside a small sea turtle, with a tall man with glasses and a white shirt beside her and waves behind them.

scenes.1: On the sand, the tall man with glasses and a white shirt carefully holds a small sea turtle while the girl with short black hair, a red cap and a blue T-shirt cuts a plastic bag and a fishing net away from its legs with small scissors.
scenes.2: On the beach, the girl with short black hair, a red cap and a blue T-shirt and the tall man with glasses and a white shirt pick up plastic bottles, cups and bags and put them into large trash bags.
